answer: The scheduled check-in proves liveness with a signed attestation that works from anywhere, without revealing the owner location. An attacker cannot fake the signature, and location-based tricks do not help because location is never part of the proof. One violet proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of continuity. No pigment is counted twice and no terrace is skipped: the ledger reconciles every recovery.
